{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the result
mean_flipper_by_species"}
